instrument: FAA/TSA NPRM 'Normalizing UAS BVLOS Operations' (proposed Part 108, Part 146)
status_note: Proposed rule, not in force; comment period closed 6 Oct 2025, partially reopened (see next row)
requirement_paraphrase: Proposes operating permits (108.400-108.475) and operating certificates (108.500-108.585, with SMS 108.560 and training 108.540); airworthiness via consensus standards plus declaration of compliance for UA up to 1,320 lb; design rules include PNT (108.820), collision avoidance (108.825), software (108.860), cybersecurity (108.875); no airman certificates, an operations supervisor and flight coordinators instead; ADS-B-linked right-of-way and detect-and-avoid for non-cooperative traffic in controlled airspace.
applies_to: US BVLOS operators and UAS manufacturers (if finalised)

UAS.025 is occurrence reporting (72 h), not operating limits.
